physcnt.title: Physical Count
physcnt.remarks: The number of this item logged the last time a physical count was performed at this location.

lotnum.title: Lot
lotnum.remarks: The lot number from which the item on this transaction originated, if the item is in a lot.

starttime.title: Start Time
starttime.remarks: Time at which work began. If you enter a Start Time and a Finish Time, Maximo calculates values for the Hours field, but will not write over a value you have already entered in the field. You can only enter a value if the work order has a status of Approve. You can modify the field until you save the record.

startdate.title: Start Date
startdate.remarks: Date on which the reported work began.

invoicelinenum.title: Invoice Line
invoicelinenum.remarks: Invoice line number of the invoice line created from this Labor Transaction.

actualdate.title: Actual Date
actualdate.remarks: Date and time of the receipt or transfer, which may be different than the time the transaction is recorded in Maximo. Maximo populates the current date and time by default. You can modify the value in this field. Click the Select Date and Time button to use the calendar control.

rollup.title: Rolled Up
rollup.remarks: Indicates whether or not this transaction has been rolled up.

rejectqty.title: Quantity Rejected
rejectqty.remarks: Number of items rejected. If you enter a number in this field, make sure the number of items in the Qunatity field is the number of items you are keeping, and not the total number of items received.

fromconditioncode.title: From Condition Code
fromconditioncode.remarks: Condition code that reflects the physical condition of the item as it was in the originating storeroom. Click the Select Value button to choose a condition code.

toolqty.title: Quantity
toolqty.remarks: Quantity of the tool used on the work order.

toolrate.title: Rate
toolrate.remarks: Rate per hour for the tool.

toolhrs.title: Hours
toolhrs.remarks: Number of hours the tool was used on the work order.

rotassetnum.title: Rotating Asset
rotassetnum.remarks: Identifies the rotating asset number associated with the item being transfered.

taskid.title: Task
taskid.remarks: Work order's task ID number associated with the line item.

enteredastask.title: Entered as Task
enteredastask.remarks: Was this transaction created against a work order task?

linecost.title: Line Cost
linecost.remarks: Line cost of the transaction, calculated as unit cost multiplied by the quantity of the item.

issueto.title: Issue To
issueto.remarks: Person or craft to whom the item or tool is being transferred. Click the Detail Menu button to choose a person or go to the People application.

issue.title: Issue on Receipt
issue.remarks: Specifies whether the line item is a direct issue to a work order, GL account, location, or asset. If the check box is selected, the line item is a direct issue. If the check box is cleared (the default), the item is stocked in a storeroom.

binnum.title: Bin
binnum.remarks: The bin number from which the item on this transaction originated.

polinenum.title: PO Line
polinenum.remarks: Line number of the item on the associated purchase order.

laborcode.title: Labor
laborcode.remarks: Identifies the person or craft performing the work.

enterby.title: Entered By
enterby.remarks: Maximo user name of the person initiating this transaction.

courier.title: Courier
courier.remarks: Company used to transfer the item across organizations. Click the Select Value button to choose a courier.

packingslipnum.title: Packing Slip
packingslipnum.remarks: Packing slip number for the received item.

tax1code.title: Tax Code 1
tax1code.remarks: Tax code used for calculation of Tax1 column.

tobin.title: To Bin
tobin.remarks: Bin number in the storeroom for the received or transferred item. Click the Select Value button to choose a bin.

costlinenum.title: Cost Line
costlinenum.remarks: Cost Line from which it was created.

commodity.title: Commodity Code
commodity.remarks: Identifies the commodity code of the item.

costinfo.title: Cost Information
costinfo.remarks: Is the cost Information on this line

tax4code.title: Tax Code 4
tax4code.remarks: Tax code used for calculation of Tax4 column.

commoditygroup.title: Commodity Group
commoditygroup.remarks: Identifies the commodity group of the item.

rejectcode.title: Reject Code
rejectcode.remarks: Code that indicates the reason items were rejected. For example, Damaged.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.remarks: Identifying code for the manufacturer of the item.

finishtime.title: End Time
finishtime.remarks: Time at which the work was finished.

skilllevel.title: Skill Level
skilllevel.remarks: Identifies the skill level of the labor.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Asset number associated with this transaction or line item.

curbal.title: Current Balance
curbal.remarks: Current balance at the time of the transfer or receipt

statuschangeby.title: Status Changed By
statuschangeby.remarks: Person who last changed the receipt status.

contractnum.title: Contract
contractnum.remarks: Identifies the contract for the outside labor for the transaction. You can select a contract based on the value in the Craft field or in the Labor field.

conditioncode.title: To Condition Code
conditioncode.remarks: Condition code that reflects the current physical condition of the item being transferred. Click the Select Value button to choose a condition code.

tolot.title: To Lot
tolot.remarks: Internal lot number into which the item being transferred or received is placed, which is different than the manufacturer's lot number. The internal lot number is used to track a received item so that it can be used in the appropriate time frame, such as first-in first-out or last-in last-out. Click the Select Value button to choose a lot.

enterdate.title: Entered Date
enterdate.remarks: Date the service use is reported.

qtyrequested.title: Quantity Requested
qtyrequested.remarks: The quantity requested for the transfer.

changeby.title: Changed By
changeby.remarks: User who last changed this record

finishdate.title: End Date
finishdate.remarks: Date on which the labor finished the work. If you have entered a Start Date, Start Time, and Finish Time, Maximo calculates a value for the Finish Date field using this formula: (start date) + (finish time - start time). The work order must be approved before you can insert a value. You can modify the field until you save the record. Maximo then updates the Line Cost field.

actualcost.title: Actual Cost
actualcost.remarks: The extended cost of the item on this transaction.

glcreditacct.title: GL Credit Account
glcreditacct.remarks: GL account being credited when the item is transferred. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

premiumpayratetype.title: Premium Rate Type
premiumpayratetype.remarks: Describes the type of premium rate, for example, hourly, incremental, or multiplier.

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: Identifies the Active Revision Number of the contract for this labor transaction.

premiumpaycode.title: Premium Pay Code
premiumpaycode.remarks: Identifies the premium pay code for this labor transaction, for example, holiday hours, Sunday hours, greater than 40 hours per week, greater than eight hours per shift.

fromsiteid.title: From Site
fromsiteid.remarks: Site from where the item is transferred. By default, Maximo uses the site of the selected storeroom. Click the Select Value button to choose a site.

premiumpayrate.title: Premium Pay Rate
premiumpayrate.remarks: Identifies the labor's rate for work done beyond the usual work shift, for example, the overtime rate. Maximo displays the premium pay rate in this read-only field and uses it to calculate the Line Cost.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the receipt status last changed.

wonum.title: Work Order
wonum.remarks: Identifies the work order for this line item.

tostoreloc.title: To Location
tostoreloc.remarks: Storeroom where the item is being transferred or received. Click the Select Value button to choose a storeroom location.

ponum.title: PO
ponum.remarks: Purchase order number associated with this item. Select the Detail Menu button to go to the Purchase Orders application.

timerstatus.title: Timer Status
timerstatus.remarks: Indicates whether a user created the labor transaction using the timer on the Maximo toolbar. If the field is blank, the timer was not used. If the field has a value, the timer was used to create this labor transaction.

genapprservreceipt.title: Approved
genapprservreceipt.remarks: Specifies whether the labor transaction has been approved and a service receipt can be written. If the check box is selected, the transaction has been approved. If the check box is cleared, the transaction has not been approved. You can edit labor transactions until the work order is closed or cancelled.

premiumpayhours.title: Premium Pay Hours
premiumpayhours.remarks: Number of hours for which the labor will be paid the premium rate.

issuetype.title: Transaction Type
issuetype.remarks: The type of Material Receipt Transaction (MatRecTrans).

issueid.title: Issue Id
issueid.remarks: The ID of the Material Issue record this return is referring to.

craft.title: Craft
craft.remarks: Identifies the craft. This field is read-only, if the Labor/Craft field contains a craft. If you edit this field, the Rate and Premium Pay Code fields are updated automatically.

frombin.title: From Bin
frombin.remarks: Bin number in this storeroom from which the item is being transferred. Click the Select Value button to choose a bin.

payrate.title: Rate
payrate.remarks: Pay rate for the labor. Maximo copies the pay rate for the labor from the labor record.

fromstoreloc.title: From Location
fromstoreloc.remarks: Storeroom from where the item is received. Click the Select Value button to choose a storeroom location.

loadedcost.title: Loaded Cost
loadedcost.remarks: The linecost of the transfer, calculated as unitcost multiplied by quantity plus taxes and special charges.

sparepartadded.title: Spare Part Added
sparepartadded.remarks: Indicates that the item was added to the spare parts list for the asset.

modelnum.title: Model
modelnum.remarks: Manufacturer's model number for the item. The default value comes from the inventory record.

changedate.title: Changed Date
changedate.remarks: Timestamp of when the transaction was approved.

rejectcost.title: Rejected Cost
rejectcost.remarks: Rejected extended or lump sum cost of this transaction line.

receivedunit.title: Order Unit
receivedunit.remarks: Standard unit by which the item is ordered, such as roll or case.

tax2code.title: Tax Code 2
tax2code.remarks: Tax code used for calculation of Tax2 column.

itemnum.title: Item
itemnum.remarks: Item that you want to transfer from this storeroom.

outside.title: Outside
outside.remarks: Specifies whether the item being transferred is a consignment good. If the check box is selected, the item belongs to a contractor (or vendor), but it is stored on-site, and it is an item for which you expect to be charged for its use. If the check box is cleared (the default), the item is not owned by an outside party.

itemsetid.title: Item Set
itemsetid.remarks: Item set identifier for this item.

qtyreturned.title: Quantity Returned
qtyreturned.remarks: Qty returned for this issue-type ISSUE

unitcost.title: Unit Cost
unitcost.remarks: Cost of the item on this transaction.

exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.remarks: Exchange rate at time of PR approval.

remark.title: Remarks
remark.remarks: Comment about the item or transaction. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

tositeid.title: Site
tositeid.remarks: Site to which the item is being issued. Click the Select Value button to choose a site.

gldebitacct.title: GL Debit Account
gldebitacct.remarks: GL account being debited when the item is received or transferred. Click the Select Value button to choose a GL account.

invoicenum.title: Invoice
invoicenum.remarks: Invoice number from the purchase order.

regularhrs.title: Regular Hours
regularhrs.remarks: Number of regular hours (not overtime, holiday, weekend, etc.) worked.

tax1.title: Tax 1
tax1.remarks: Amount of tax due on line item levied by Tax1Code.

requestedby.title: Requested By
requestedby.remarks: Person who asked for the item.

tax2.title: Tax 2
tax2.remarks: Amount of tax due on line item levied by Tax2Code.

tax3code.title: Tax Code 3
tax3code.remarks: Tax code used for calculation of Tax3 column.

tax5.title: Tax 5
tax5.remarks: Amount of tax due on line item levied by Tax5Code.

tax3.title: Tax 3
tax3.remarks: Amount of tax due on line item levied by Tax3Code.

conversion.title: Conversion Factor
conversion.remarks: Numeric value that is applied to relate an order unit to an issue unit. For example, if you order light bulbs in bulk, your unit of measure might be a case, with a quantity received of 36. But when you issue the item, you issue it one at a time. In this case, you can define a measure unit of CASE and another measure unit of EACH. You define a conversion ratio from CASE to EACH with a factor of 36. When you receive an order of this item into a storeroom, MAXIMO converts the received order unit of one CASE into the storeroom's issue unit of 36 EACH.

tax4.title: Tax 4
tax4.remarks: Amount of tax due on line item levied by Tax4Code.

paymenttransdate.title: Recorded as Received
paymenttransdate.remarks: The date and time the transaction was recorded in Purchasing.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.remarks: This field indicates the quantity in/out. It is a calculation of items addedand or subtracted.

transdate.title: Transaction Date
transdate.remarks: Date and time the transaction was entered in Maximo. This field is read only.

positeid.title: PO Site ID
positeid.remarks: The siteid where the po was created.

fromlot.title: From Lot
fromlot.remarks: Manufacturer's batch, or lot, from which the item is being taken. Click the Select Value button to choose a lot.

tax5code.title: Tax Code 5
tax5code.remarks: Tax code used for calculation of Tax5 column.

matusetransid.title: Kit Use Identifier
matusetransid.remarks: Used when breaking an inventory Kit, this is the identifier of the MatUseTrans record for the Kit item.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Location where the item will be used.

proratecost.title: Prorate Cost
proratecost.remarks: Amount of special charges loaded onto the line item.
